summary: The Bank of Nova Scotia filed a Form 6-K furnishing legal opinions and consents tied to an ordinary senior medium-term note takedown: US$400M floating-rate notes due 2029, US$600M 5.407% fixed-to-floating notes due 2029, US$700M 5.632% fixed-to-floating notes due 2030, and US$600M 5.851% fixed-to-floating notes due 2032, totaling US$2.3B. Issuance runs under the October 1, 2026 Distribution Agreement and October 13, 2026 Terms Agreement with Scotia Capital (USA) as lead agent, under the 2010 base indenture as supplemented. This is routine debt shelf funding, not a special situation; watch only funding spreads and rollover cadence.
